verdict_reason: _distinct_n reproduces Li et al. 2016 Distinct-n (distinct n-gram types / TOTAL generated tokens) to rel <= 1e-15 over 30 random token strings at n = 1, 2, 3, against an independently written reference. _distinct_n_corpus correctly implements the COLLECTION-level ratio rather than the mean of per-completion ratios: on ten duplicate [1,2] completions it returns 0.100000 where the per-completion mean is 1.000000 -- the distinction that matters precisely when a model is degenerate.
comparable_reason: Sampling is pinned by the shipped defaults (seed 42, top_k 0, temperature 0.8), and top_k = 0 is explicitly set so generate() cannot silently apply its own 50-token truncation.
github_reason: Distinct-n is a closed-form definition; reimplemented directly from Li et al. 2016 Sec 5.2 as the reference.
paper_reason: Li et al. publish Distinct-n for their own dialogue models; no number corresponds to this corpus and generation protocol.
confounds_reason: Measured on the SHIPPED configuration: deterministic (0 of 12 float keys differ between identical runs), invariant to document order, and unchanged when N goes 20 -> 40. NOTE: a bare-dict construction bypasses defaults.yaml and IS non-deterministic (1.92% on distinct_1), because generation_diversity.py:205 defaults seed to None and only seeds when it is not None. That is a property of calling the class directly, not of any shipped route, and is recorded so it is not re-filed as a defect.
fix: No change required. Optional hardening: default `seed` in code to 42 rather than None, so a direct constructor call is reproducible without defaults.yaml.
